description: Finnish company annual accounts: list the fiscal years a Finnish company has filed in XBRL with the PRH (Finnish Patent and Registration Office, CC BY 4.0). Only ~5% of Finnish limited companies file digitally: an empty answer does not mean no accounts exist. Empty filings are filtered out: every listed year carries figures. No default-risk score is computed for this country yet: the response carries score_defaillance (statut non_evaluable, closed-list reasons that GET /v1/lecture explains); never read it as a low score. Paid via x402 ($0.01 in USDC or EURC). FI accounts are served only for a company the live PRH profile serves, as /evenements: a Business ID unknown to the PRH (a sole trader, toiminimi, or a name under objection) gets the profile's 404 (entreprise_inconnue), a company form that does not prove a legal person (branch of a foreign trader) gets forme_juridique_non_servie, a PRH outage gets 503; never billed (rule R1). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.
